en.headline: Observatory extends afternoon thunderstorm warning to 6:30pm
en.dek: A warning issued at 3:55pm was kept in force until 6:30pm, with isolated storms expected over Hong Kong.
body: The Hong Kong Observatory said a thunderstorm warning issued at 3:55pm on Friday had been extended until 6:30pm. Isolated thunderstorms were expected over Hong Kong.

The Observatory advised people outdoors to seek safe shelter, to leave the water, and not to swim or take part in other outdoor water sports. It also said people should not stand on high ground and should keep away from conductive objects, trees and masts.
The afternoon warning is separate from the one issued at 11:50am and later extended to 2:30pm. The latest text was dispatched at 4:30pm.

zh.headline: 天文台下午雷暴警告延長至6時30分
zh.dek: 下午3時55分發出的雷暴警告延長至下午6時30分，預料本港有局部地區雷暴。
body: 天文台表示，周五下午3時55分發出的雷暴警告已延長至下午6時30分，預料香港有局部地區雷暴。
天文台提醒，雷暴發生時如身處室外應到安全地方躲避，並離開水面，切勿在戶外游泳或進行其他戶外水上運動。市民亦不應站立於高地，並應遠離導電物體、樹木或桅杆。
今午這則警告與上午11時50分發出、其後延長至下午2時30分的雷暴警告屬不同一次。最新天氣稿於下午4時30分發出。
